decisions.reason: Substantial investment and public commitment, with pandemic-related weak demand seen as temporary, justify persistence.
As a full mobile sports floor system with significant sunk costs and a dedicated launch page, escalation pressure keeps it in the portfolio.
Similar to Product B, its investment and public commitment, plus temporary sports-venue disruptions, support continued retention.
High centrality to the announced style-oriented direction, strong visibility on the home page, and close fit with the established offer make dropping very unlikely.
As a niche squash-court surface finish with lower investment and little alignment to the firm's announced direction, escalation pressures are weaker and dropping is more likely.
An accessory with limited sunk costs and peripheral fit, its disappointing results are less likely to be excused by temporary causes, so management is more inclined to release resources.
